title: fix: run detached generations under the zone's 300 s timeout
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Detached non-stream generations now run through gen.pollinations.ai’s public origin, giving provider calls the zone’s 300-second timeout instead of the Durable Object’s 125-second proxy read timeout. This applies to text, image, audio and video jobs; calls silent for more than 300 seconds can still time out. The coordinator retains deduplication, rejoining, settlement and R2 caching. Production and staging use the public-origin handoff, while development runs jobs in-process. A staging Qwen3.7 Flash request completed after 213 seconds, and a disconnect followed by an identical rejoin produced one handoff and one charge.
